correctness.rationale: Exact mixed multinomial moments prove the formula for all B≥3 and N≥r+s; a strictly decreasing consecutive-ratio proves interval structure. Expansion of the same exact ratio through B^{-2} yields the double-zero condition and H(a)=1. A uniform local expansion proves sharp integer cutoffs up to O_k(1); exact limits for p_r and p_s establish the covariance profile. The included standalone program completed 10,634 finite exact-arithmetic and asymptotic consistency assertions. Finite checks are not extrapolated to an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The critical consecutive-square class is natural because it is exactly the integer locus of double roots in leading covariance asymptotics. This arithmetic degeneracy creates a nontrivial, sharply quantified mesoscopic positive covariance island between negative regimes, invisible to conventional first-order asymptotics and directly pertinent to sampling-frequency statistics.
